notes.title: Paddlers, Meet Forgotten Fragments
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Paddlers![/b][/h3][p]So… you like suffering. We get it. You bought [i]Paddle Paddle Paddle[/i]. You willingly picked up a paddle and said, “Yes, I want to rage and maybe yell at my friends a little.”[/p][p]Well, good news. There’s a [b]brand new way to ruin friendships[/b] on Steam right now. It’s called [b]Forgotten Fragments[/b] and it just released a few days ago by fellow deveopers Binary Phoenix (they're awesome guys!).[/p][p]It’s a fantastic game. It’s also an enraging game. But don’t worry, it’s not the same flavor of rage as paddling into sawblades for the 384th time. It’s a [i]different kind[/i] of frustration. Variety is important.[/p][p]And the best part? [b]It also has a friendship-testing co-op mode.[/b]
So if your friendship and temper survived paddling, maybe you’re ready for the next trial.[/p][p]👉 You can grab both games together in a shiny bundle: [b]Paddle Paddle Paddle + Forgotten Fragments = Double the Chaos[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59935/Forgotten_Fragments__Paddle_Paddle_Paddle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Check it out, try it with your friends, and let us know how long the friendships last this time.[/p][h3][b]Happy raging,
– Mateo[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59935/Forgotten_Fragments__Paddle_Paddle_Paddle/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59935/Forgotten_Fragments__Paddle_Paddle_Paddle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]what the...it keeps posting the link[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59935/Forgotten_Fragments__Paddle_Paddle_Paddle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]whatever...[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59935/Forgotten_Fragments__Paddle_Paddle_Paddle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]just get it already...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59935/Forgotten_Fragments__Paddle_Paddle_Paddle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]thank you, big <3 love[/p]

notes.title: Post-Launch Hotfix #15
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I still work hard everyday to make the game better and listen to your feedback! Here are some News:

-> You can now switch Skins ingame in the Pause Menu so you do not have to go back to the home-menu to switch skins anymore!

-> Im aware of the connection and delay problems for some chinese players and Im actively working on a solution right now! Im really sorry about the problems and frustration but its my first time developing a game with Online-Multiplayer so I still have to learn a lot in this topic!

-> Im really happy about the Speedrun community for Paddle Paddle Paddle! I just made a Speedrun . com page for the game and you are welcome to [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Paddle_Paddle_Paddle]submit your time[/url] (with a video proof) there. The ingame leaderboard is sadly not protected against Cheaters...

[b][u]Regarding the Recent Difficulty-Changes:[/u][/b]
I read the Feedback regarding my recent nerfs which made the game easier at some areas. I want to be clear with you: I got a lot of negative Feedback from Streamers (who stopped playing the game because it was too frustrating and boring) and from Steam Reviews which just insulted me for making the game too hard. I want the game to be a fun Coop experience. It is not meant to be the Hardest Game ever (some people described it like that...) Im sorry for the missunderstanding and I can understand if you do not want to play the game anymore!

-> Meteorites spawn slower (longer time until impact)
-> Waterslides got slower and more fair
And more...

notes.title: Daaaaang! 20,000 (well-adjusted) Paddlers
notes.notes:
[h1]20,000 Paddlers?! Y’all Doubled Down on the Pain ...[/h1][p][/p][p]Okay, wait—[b]what just happened?[/b][/p][p]We were still busy celebrating the [i]10k paddlers[/i] milestone, proudly handing out #10k golden paddles like participation trophies from hell… and now we're here like:[/p][h3][b]“Oh. Cool. It’s 20,000 now.”[/b][/h3][p]So…
[b]20,000 raging but happy paddlers.[/b]
[b]20,000 brave (or very confused) souls.[/b]
[b]20,000 chances for a co-op friendship to go horribly wrong.[/b][/p][p]We don’t know what you saw in this cursed boat journey, but we love you for it. 💙[/p][p][/p][h3]🎁 New Cosmetics. More Chaos.[/h3][p]To properly honor this completely unhinged milestone, we’re giving everyone [b]two new free cosmetics[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Canoe:[/b] It’s longer. It’s sleek. It changes absolutely nothing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Cowboy Hat:[/b] Because obviously you’re the sheriff of this lake now.[/p][/*][/list][p]You might be wondering:[/p][quote][p]“Wait… why a canoe? Why a cowboy hat?”
And to that, we say: [b]Germans might get it.[/b][/p][/quote][p]If you happen to catch the current [url="https://www.twitch.tv/handofblood"]HandOfBlood livestream[/url] — well, things might start to make [i]slightly more[/i] sense.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536714/9b57d6d4b43c810e31ddd6563f04d309c625a756.png"][/img][/p][p][i](Just to be clear: this isn’t an official collab. Just a heartfelt tribute to a comedic legend... and chaos, cowboy energy, and high-stakes co-op disasters.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]🤠From the bottom of our leaky boat:[/h3][p][b]THANK YOU.[/b]

Seriously.

For the laughs, the rage, the streams, the screenshots, the speedruns, the bug reports, the memes, the wishlists, and everything in between.[/p][p]You’ve made [i]Paddle Paddle Paddle[/i] something incredibly special. And we’re just getting started.[/p][p]Now grab your golden paddle, hop in your canoe, tip your cowboy hat, and [b]keep on paddlin’.[/b]

[b]You absolute legends.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]💙 [b]– Mateo & the Assemble Entertainment Crew[/b][/p]

notes.title: Post-launch Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hello,

here is Mateo, the solodev behind Paddle Paddle Paddle! Im Super happy to announce the first Update for the game! I watched a lot of videos, got tons of feedback and Im here to improve the game as much as possible! 

Here are the Changes:

-> The Camera controls were a big problem for many of you, so from now on the default setting is a free-moving camera, that you can control with your mouse or the right joystick on the controller. You can find options to deactivate this setting, changing the camera sensitivity and inverting the camera movement in the settings. I hope that you will enjoy this new feature!

-> The Pipes Puzzle was really confusing for a lot of you and Im really sorry about that! The arrows now point into the move direction that you have to choose from your perspective.

-> Im super sorry about the buggy Achievements! They should all work now as intended! Im really sorry about that!

-> I also nerfed the difficulty at some areas that were so hard that they were just not fun anymore. I want to deliver a hard game, but it should be fun to play too.

I will work to build in more of your feedback! Please submit all your ideas / feedback via the Feedback form in the Main Menu. 

Im a solodev and student after all so I do not develop games fulltime yet and things can time some time to be improved but I try my best to make the game better and better!

Thank you so much and have a great day!

Best regards,
Mateo (ZoroArts)

notes.title: Paddle Paddle Paddle Launches July 25!
notes.notes: [h3][b]Hey Paddleheads![/b][/h3][p]It’s happening! After countless hours of furious paddling, rage-quitting, and laughing at my own dumb level designs, I'm thrilled (and slightly terrified) to announce that [b]Paddle Paddle Paddle officially launches on July 25![/b] 🎉[/p][p]That’s right! Soon you'll be able to subject yourself (and your friends) to the ultimate test of patience, precision, and paddling prowess. Whether you're a lone paddler or enjoy chaotic co-op suffering, your time has come.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Oh, there's a new trailer too![/b][/h3][p]Feast your eyes on the [b]brand-new trailer[/b], now live! It’s got paddles. It’s got pain. It’s got majestic frustration in glorious motion... and lots of [b]PADDLE[/b]![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="CO3Ed03CV7I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]What to expect:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Ridiculous physics and tight (but slightly cursed) controls[/p][/*][*][p]1–2 player local and online co-op; because misery loves company[/p][/*][*][p]Ramps, sawblades, spinning death logs... classic paddlecore[/p][/*][*][p]That one level you’ll definitely uninstall the game over[/p][/*][*][p]And a bunch of laughs along the way[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Wishlist now. Rage later.[/b][/h3][p]If you haven’t already, [b]wishlist the game[/b], tell your friends, your dog, your yoga instructor. The more, the messier. It helps a ton.[/p][p]See you [b]July 25[/b]. Bring your paddles.💙[/p][p][/p][p][b]– Mateo & the Assemble Entertainment Crew[/b][/p]

notes.title: Paddle Paddle Paddle Demo Is Here (to Ruin Your Friendships)! 🎉

[h3][b]Hey Paddlers![/b][/h3][p]It’s [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and [b]Paddle Paddle Paddle[/b] is paddling full speed into the madness with a demo that must feel like that little guy who was tasked with throwing a certain ring into the flaming lava of a certain mountain—yeah, kinda like that![/p][p][b]So, whatever ... Grab your oar, steel your patience, and dive in … if you dare.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛶 [b]What’s in the demo?[/b][/h3][p]A taste of pure, unfiltered chaos. Test your skills (and sanity) solo or in online/local co-op with a friend. I highly recommend dragging someone down with you—because if you're going to suffer, you might as well [i]laugh/cry/scream together[/i].[/p][p]Navigate wild obstacles, survive dorky characters, and try your best not to destroy your keyboard. Or each other.[/p][p]💬 Like what you played? [i]Leaving a review would be a huge help![/i][/p][p][b]Even if you hated it. We embrace the salt. We live in the salt. They're helping me get the word out, support the game's journey, and shout into the storm with me.[/p][p]Welcome aboard, crew—I can't wait to paddle straight into glorious disaster together.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 [b]Shoutout to the brave Naiaru[/b][/h3][p]A massive thank-you (and possibly an ice pack) to [b][url="https://www.artstation.com/naiaru"]Naiaru[/url][/b], who dove headfirst into lava (a.k.a. production chaos) to bring you the [b]brand-new key artwork [/b](and logo) for [b]Paddle Paddle Paddle[/b].[/p][p]It perfectly captures the charm, challenge, and absurdity of our game. Go check him out and shower him with love—he deserves it.[/p][p][b]🔥 Bruised. Battered. Brilliant.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45536714/5a908478a45dad35cb8ca54e6753a03911898ae1.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for the support, the memes, and the inevitable rage-quits. We’re just getting started.[/p][p]🛶 Keep paddling, embrace the chaos. And remember: quitting is for the dry.[/p][p][/p][p][b]– Mateo & the Assemble Entertainment Crew[/b][/p]
